findings.title: HTTP 429 treated as quality-neutral transport
findings.detail: Lane E marks 429 as RATE_LIMITED/quality-neutral. assert_429_not_quality_failure correctly rejects quality-field pollution, but V11 record_provider_outcome does not invoke that invariant itself.
findings.remediation: Call assert_429_not_quality_failure inside record_provider_outcome when status is RATE_LIMITED and any quality fields are present.

findings.title: Critic can complete before Reasoner success
findings.detail: ProviderScheduler queues are independent; record_provider_outcome allows SAMBANOVA_INDEPENDENT_CRITIC SUCCESS with zero Groq completed cases. build_critic_order filters, but dispatch authority does not enforce ordering.
findings.remediation: Gate Critic begin_attempt on Reasoner SUCCESS for the same case_id (completed_case_ids / deduper), fail-closed otherwise.

findings.title: Completed-case replay blocked by deduper
findings.detail: SuccessfulCallDeduper blocks second dispatch; dedupe_completed_cases preserves order.
findings.remediation: Keep hydrate_deduper_from_state wired on every real resume path.

findings.title: Checkpoint integrity ignores success_count vs completed-case drift
findings.detail: integrity_checksum covers transport blob but does not enforce semantic consistency between success_count and completed_case_ids. evaluate_terminal trusts max(success_count, len(completed_case_ids)), so inflated counters can satisfy the groq_success>=80 capacity gate.
findings.remediation: Add semantic counter invariants to detect_corruption / migrate_checkpoint; refuse terminal evaluation when success_count != len(completed_case_ids) for Groq (and Critic resolved vs success).

findings.title: Legacy UNDETERMINED_PROCESS migrates to UNDETERMINED
findings.detail: migrate_process_classification preserves legacy raw while canonicalizing taxonomy.
findings.remediation: None required for migration helper; keep legacy raw in disagreement records.

findings.title: Lesson gate blocks policy-effect lessons while V2.3 incomplete
findings.detail: apply_lesson_gate_v11 zeros lesson count for incomplete/fixture terminals.
findings.remediation: Optional: rename lesson_prevention_executed so True means prevention engaged when lessons are blocked.

findings.title: Future timestamp hidden in nested evidence bypasses PIT exclusion
findings.detail: prove_future_data_exclusion only inspects top-level source/retrieval/availability fields on each record. Nested evidence timestamps after as_of are ignored.
findings.remediation: Recursively scan record trees for *_timestamp_ms / available_as_of_ms / as_of_ms fields and fail closed on any value > as_of_ms.

findings.title: OOS cryptographic seal can be regenerated after reserved-interval mutation
findings.detail: build_oos_cryptographic_seal always recomputes a fresh seal from current inputs. There is no persisted seal binding, anti-regeneration check, or seal lineage.
findings.remediation: Persist first seal under write-once semantics; verify regenerations against stored seal and fail closed on reserved-registry mutation after seal creation.

findings.title: Founder auth result is spoofable and decoupled from promotion gate
findings.detail: evaluate() fail-closes authorization, but returned dicts are not integrity-bound. PromotionStateMachine.attempt_promote never consults FounderAuthorizationGate; blocking relies solely on unconditional PROMOTION_BLOCKED_READY.
findings.remediation: Bind founder gate output to a checksum/HMAC and require that proof inside attempt_promote before any non-blocked transition is even considered.

findings.title: Promotion state machine remains BLOCKED_READY
findings.detail: attempt_promote always denies; all qualification stages stay BLOCKED_READY.
findings.remediation: Retain hard block until Founder-authorized post-OOS path exists.

rationale: Critical adversarial failures remain after Pass 2. Do not declare Lane E/F integrated PASS until remediation exists.
